Add Vercel custom event tracking for key user actions

Tracks four core conversion events:
- Generate: fired when user submits a prompt \(with input length\)
- PlanGenerated: server-side, fired after AI responds \(with schedule size, deadline/meal flags\)
- AddToCalendar: fired when user confirms and saves blocks \(with block count\)
- Signup: fired when user initiates Google sign-in

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Fix AI language understanding: timezone, history context, filter, temperature, timeout

- Send real user timezone from browser \(Intl.DateTimeFormat\) instead of hardcoded Europe/Madrid
- Send last 5 planning history items with every request for personalization
- Loosen hallucination filter — keep legitimate AI additions \(study sessions, meal blocks, routines\)
- Increase temperature 0.5 → 0.7 for more natural, human-feeling scheduling
- Increase API timeout 12s → 25s to prevent errors on complex inputs
- Import loadHistory in page.tsx for history context helper

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
